data.title: Comparing River Floods
data.passage: Heavy rain storms cause waters to rise rapidly in local valleys. However, melting snowpacks create a different kind of overflow. Both events fill river channels beyond normal capacity. Similarly, blocked drainage paths make water spill over banks. Unlike natural floods, urban runoff happens much faster.
